_comment: Seed deployment UUIDs + coordinates from ww-backend/supabase/seeds/dev/data.sql (NZ monitoring org c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000005). These are deterministic across every `supabase db reset`, so the stamped images always bind to the same deployments. prepare.py writes the deployment_id into EXIF UserComment (exact match) and the GPS coords (proximity fallback).
